title: Publish scheduler usage-measurement consumer surface
description: Objective: make the landed provider-neutral usage measurement contract executable through the bare @moe/scheduler package root so a provider telemetry composer can use the production authority rather than copy its source/coverage matrix. Deliverable: a curated root export of UsageMeasurementRecord, normalizeUsageMeasurement, the exact coverage/source/code/layer vocabularies and required type closure, with package-root/runtime tests. Consumer: task-159f4c21ef9149e8a65f24735c9c1475. NOT in scope: new normalization semantics, provider parsing, pricing, benchmark gates, or edits to the 250-line measurement kernels. Owned paths: packages/scheduler/src/index.ts and packages/scheduler/src/index-surface.test.ts only. Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/scheduler typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/scheduler test.
definitionOfDone: @moe/scheduler root exports normalizeUsageMeasurement plus UsageMeasurementRecord, NormalizedMeasurement, PricebookBinding, coverage/source/code/layer vocabularies, and the exact callable type closure; no direct enumerator, policy, fixture, or incidental helper leaks.
